p.detail: rasq.billing / version 1.0.0-draft.20261007. Reference translation of the user-facing text of the Japanese draft (tool/legal/build_legal.py).

p.text: Reference translation. This is a reference translation provided for convenience. The Japanese version is the official text, and if there is any difference between them, the Japanese version governs.

source.text: These conditions apply to paid use of RASQ Points, ASTell, Plugins, and the Plugin proxy sold by Mikihisa Goho. The features, supported environments, usage limits, prices, and contract periods of each product are displayed on the purchase screen. The person who develops and licenses a Plugin is displayed separately on the product screen.
During the public test period

, the Operator does not sell points, offer paid Plugins, or offer ASTell or the Plugin proxy on a paid basis. The only fees the Operator receives during this period are the review fees paid by Plugin developers (the conditions for review fees are set out in the Plugin Store and developer conditions). When paid offerings begin after the public test ends, the Operator will give advance notice of the final version of these conditions.

1. Points are purchased through Stripe for the total payment amount in yen displayed on the purchase screen. Before purchase, the number of paid points, whether there are free bonuses, the total payment amount, tax treatment, expiry, and the products for which they can be used are displayed. The purchase agreement is formed when payment processing is completed and the granting of points is notified.

2. Paid points can be used to pay for eligible products at a value equivalent to 1 yen per point. The treatment of fractions is displayed before purchase. The minimum purchase unit and the upper limit are
【TBD】

3. Purchased points and points granted free of charge are displayed separately. Points cannot be transferred, sent between users, resold, or exchanged for cash. However, this does not prevent refunds required by law or refunds for erroneous payments, inability to provide, and the like.
4. Registering card information alone does not cause points to be purchased automatically. If auto-charge is offered, applications will be accepted separately, with the conditions and limits shown.

p.title: Article 3. Expiry and Order of Use

source.text: 1. Points expire one month after each grant (at the same date and time in the following month; if the following month has no such day, on the last day of that month), and the expiry date and time in Japan time is displayed before purchase and on the balance screen. Unused points expire once the expiry has passed. A new purchase does not extend the expiry of earlier points.

2. Valid points are used starting with those with the earliest expiry. Among points with the same expiry, free points are used before paid points, and paid points are used in order of oldest grant. The breakdown of points used is displayed in the usage history.
3. Even if the expiry of points already used arrives later, rights to use Plugins already purchased and service periods already paid for do not lapse for that reason alone.

4. If points could not be used within their validity period due to a failure on the Operator's side, the Operator will investigate the impact and provide guidance on extending the expiry or other measures. If the points system is terminated, the Operator will give advance notice of the end date of use and the handling of balances, and will make any necessary refunds and the like in accordance with law.

1. When a product is purchased with points, the points corresponding to the confirmed order are consumed and the right of use is granted, and completion is notified. Consumption alone is not finalized without the right of use being granted. If an inconsistency occurs, the Operator reconciles the records and provides the product or returns the points.

2. For one-time purchase products, you acquire a right to use the features and versions shown on the purchase screen. The maintenance period, supported environments, fees for additional services, and conditions for migrating to future paid versions are shown on the same screen. This does not mean that all future versions, perpetual compatibility with external SNSs, or server services under separate agreements are included.

3. Subscriptions renew at the number of points and cycle shown on the initial confirmation screen. The date and time of the first and next consumption, the period of use, whether renewal is automatic, limits, and fees for the next and subsequent periods are clearly indicated. If you have applied for automatic renewal from your point balance, the fee for the next period is consumed under the same conditions.

4. If valid points are insufficient at renewal, the paid provision stops at the end of the period already paid for, and you are notified of the insufficient balance. Fees for periods not provided are not automatically deferred, nor covered by card charges that were not separately applied for. Resumption requires an operation to reconfirm the fee and start date.

5. If the number of points required for renewal is changed, advance notice is given and acceptance of renewal after the change is requested. If it is not accepted, the subscription stops at the end of the period already paid for. Additional features and usage-based fees are not added without separate confirmation.

6. When multiple agreements renew at the same date and time, they are processed in the priority order set on the agreements screen. If no order is set, they are processed in the order in which the agreements were started, and the order for agreements started at the same time is also displayed on that screen. Each agreement is renewed if the full amount required for it can be paid, and agreements for which points are insufficient are stopped. The total required for the next renewals, the balance valid until then, and any expected shortfall can be checked on the agreements screen.

1. Automatic renewal can be stopped from "Active services" before the next renewal. The completion screen displays the date and time the stop of renewal was accepted and the date and time until which the service can be used. If you cannot complete the procedure, it is accepted through the inquiry contact.

2. Even if automatic renewal is stopped, the service can be used until the end of the period already paid for. For cancellation partway through a period for the user's own reasons, no refund or return of points is made for the remaining period, except where different conditions were shown at the time of purchase or where required by law.
3. Uninstalling the app, logging out, or deleting a Plugin alone does not stop automatic renewal.

4. When accepting a request to delete a RASQ account, the Operator stops the next renewal of agreements it manages and auto-charge. The effect on the balance, purchased rights of use, and refund procedures is shown on the confirmation screen, and the necessary procedures are explained. The Operator does not allow a state in which only charges continue after the account is deleted. If immediate deletion is chosen, the point at which access to features for periods already paid for will be lost is also clearly indicated.
【pending approval: proposed settlement upon withdrawal】

For unused paid points upon withdrawal for the user's own reasons, the balance is reconciled with the original purchases, and settlement to the original payment method is accepted by a method permitted by law. Free points expire upon withdrawal and are not converted into money. When settlement is made after acceptance, the quantity covered, the amount, the expected timing, and an inquiry number for use after withdrawal are notified. This proposal will be adopted after confirmation of the applicable refund restrictions and payment conditions is completed.

6. Even if the account is deleted, the license for a lawfully acquired one-time purchase product survives within the scope of that product's license. However, re-download, purchase restoration, and access to active services through the account end. Features already obtained on the device that do not require account authentication or other services can be used within the scope of the license. Features that require authentication, a proxy, or the like, and data that needs to be exported or backed up, are specifically displayed before deletion. Existing purchase records are not transferred to a new account without identity verification.

p.title: Article 6. Defects, Refunds, and Disputes over Charges

source.text: 1. For double payments, failure to grant after payment, provision differing from what was purchased, and serious defects attributable to the Operator that cannot be resolved, you can file a claim from your purchase history or, if you have withdrawn or cannot log in, through the inquiry contact. Your relationship to the purchase is confirmed using the order number, payment records, and the like. After investigation, the Operator restores provision, refunds the payment, or returns the points consumed. The Operator does not end its response merely by directing you to contact the developer.

2. When points are returned due to cancellation of a product purchase, the breakdown of paid and free points is restored. If the original expiry has passed or will pass immediately at the time of return, the period during which the points can be used is the later of 30 days from the date of return or the original expiry. If points returned cannot be used because of the termination of the points system, inability to provide, or similar reasons, the Operator will provide guidance on a monetary refund or the like according to applicable law and the payment status.

3. When cancellation of a point purchase is accepted, the balance concerned and its usage are reconciled, and as a rule the refund is made to the original payment method. The expected processing period is notified. The actual date on which it is reflected may differ depending on processing by the card company or others.

4. Mail-order sales are not subject to the same cooling-off system as door-to-door sales and the like, but this does not uniformly exclude rights under law such as rescission by minors, rescission for misrepresentation, and rights relating to non-performance of contract. Conditions for returns and cancellations for the user's own reasons are shown on the product screen and the final order confirmation screen.

5. If the Operator terminates a paid service, as a rule it returns, on a pro rata basis, the consideration corresponding to the portion of the period already paid for that will not be provided. If points returned would have nowhere to be used, the paid portion is settled in money in accordance with law and the breakdown of the original payment. Where the main features at the time of purchase become unavailable due to the termination of an essential proxy or the like for a one-time purchase product, the Operator will also consider alternative provision or a full or partial return according to the extent of unavailability. The no-refund conditions for cancellation for the user's own reasons do not apply to termination by the Operator.
